### Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] I read the [contributing guide](https://github.com/element-hq/element-call-ios/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I am aware of the [etiquette](https://github.com/element-hq/element-call-ios/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#etiquette).
- [ ] Pull request contains a [changelog label](https://github.com/element-hq/element-call-ios/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#changelog).
- [ ] No module imports `Compound` or `MatrixRustSDK`. Colours, icons and Matrix access go through the ports.
- [ ] This PR has been made with the help of an LLM.

**UI changes have been tested with:**
- [ ] iPhone and iPad simulators in portrait and landscape orientations.
- [ ] Dark mode enabled and disabled.
- [ ] Various sizes of dynamic type.
- [ ] Voiceover enabled.
- [ ] Snapshots re-recorded on the pinned device and OS.
